title: Fast-Track Cardano Development: Introducing the Scalus In-Memory Emulator
description:
In this Developers Office Hour, we are joined by Alex Nemish (CTO & Founder) and Serhii Lekariev (Senior Engineer) from Lantr to explore the Scalus Emulator.

Scalus provides a powerful in-memory Cardano node emulator designed to drastically shorten the development cycle. By simulating a Cardano node within JVM, JavaScript, and TypeScript environments, it allows developers to test smart contracts and dApp logic without the overhead of a full local node or testnet.

Key highlights of the session:

Optimizing the Dev Cycle: Reducing the friction between writing code and seeing results.

In-Memory Node Emulator: How Scalus simulates Cardano ledger state for rapid testing.

Workflow Integration: Identifying exactly where the emulator fits into your CI/CD and local development pipelines.

SDK Integrations: Using Scalus alongside existing tools to build more robust applications.

This session is a must-watch for developers looking to improve their testing efficiency and iterate faster on the Cardano blockchain.

#Cardano #Scalus #BlockchainTesting #CardanoDevelopers #JVM #TypeScript #SmartContracts #Lantr #Web3Development
